body: Bars in a vault can't buy coffee, cross a border, or back a loan. Auri puts real gold in your name — 1:1, vaulted in Switzerland, attested quarterly — then lets you spend it on a card, send it in seconds, or borrow against it. Anyone can hold gold. Auri lets you use it.
